name: grok-bot-local
description: Grok Bot local — chrome officiel + flotte GPT-6-ASTRA 10.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @grok-bot/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @grok-bot/server" "npm run dev -w @grok-bot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @grok-bot/shared && npm run build -w @grok-bot/server && npm run build -w @grok-bot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @grok-bot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @grok-bot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @grok-bot/server && npm run typecheck -w @grok-bot/web
scripts.test:seed: npm run build -w @grok-bot/shared && npx tsx apps/server/src/db/seed.test.ts
scripts.dev:desktop: npm --prefix apps/desktop install && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dev
